'''''Potentilla supina''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] belonging to the family [[Rosaceae]].<ref name="POWO">{{cite web |title=''Potentilla supina'' L. {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:729071-1 |website=Plants of the World Online |access-date=14 February 2021 |language=en}}</ref>

Its native range is the temperate and subtropical Northern Hemisphere and Southern Africa.<ref name="POWO" />
